purpose: Teach: カジュアル/リベラル/オールド/エコノミー/ノーマン/ヘルパー/カセット/イレブン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカジュアルなコーディネートを楽しまれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been really enjoying putting together casual outfits lately.
lines.style: Warm, almost teasing observation. Gentle pace. A small smile in the voice—noticing something endearing about him. Tone of someone sharing a quiet delight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとリベラルな政治討論番組観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a political debate show with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Open, unguarded. Quick tempo on the report—he wants her to know. Small genuine excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオールドファンの映画祭に行かれるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's planning to go to a classic film festival.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Slight warm affection underneath—she's noticing patterns in him. Calm, observant tone. A beat of tenderness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエコノミークラスでの旅行記読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a travel essay with Dad about economy class trips.
lines.style: Open, earnest. Simple delivery—he's just telling her what happened. No filter, no performance. Warm and direct.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがノーマン・ロックウェルの画集を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been looking at a Norman Rockwell art book.
lines.style: Soft, reflective observation. She's gathering these details, piecing together something she loves about him. Unhurried. Quiet delight in noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお祖父ちゃんのヘルパーさんとお話したよ
lines.en: Mom, I talked with Dad and Grandpa's caregiver today.
lines.style: Open and proud—something he did mattered. Straightforward delivery. Brightness of a child who helped or learned something. Unself-conscious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカセットテープの音楽を流して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been playing music from old cassette tapes for us.
lines.style: Warm, quiet wonder in her voice. She's noticing him creating small moments. Slow, gentle pace. A note of gratitude underneath—for the thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサッカー日本代表イレブンの応援したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I cheered for the Japanese national soccer team together.
lines.style: Bright, direct joy. Quick energy but genuine—not showing off, just sharing something fun. Open-hearted. A small lift at the close.
